description:
## Goal
Move every maintained named-function source and every user-facing contract to def/defp while both compiler entry points are temporarily available, so the later deletion is a small, provable removal rather than a flag-day break hidden among semantic changes.

## Known migration surface
Current main contains 2,221 line-leading fn/fnp definition candidates across 659 `.fz` files, 107 `extern ABI fn` declarations, runtime and standard-library sources, compiler and CLI source strings, 653+ fixture programs and sidecars, and 24 guide/agent-doc files containing fn/fnp text that require classification. Anonymous `fn ... -> ... end` is not a migration target. Rust function declarations and prose such as function are not targets.

## Strategy
Use a syntax-aware or tightly classified mechanical rewrite, not a blind word replacement:
- named public fn -> def;
- named private fnp -> defp;
- protocol callback fn -> def;
- extern ABI fn -> contextual def;
- anonymous fn remains fn;
- typed operator definitions in lib/kernel.fz gain parentheses around each annotated operand so the generic expression grammar produces the intended operator head.
Migrate executable sources first, then source strings and fixture-discovery conventions, then documentation and examples. Inspect every residual match and classify it explicitly.

## TDD and signal
Before rewriting, land focused all-door fixtures for guarded quicksort, defp privacy, protocol callbacks, externs, zero-arity no-parens definitions, and typed operator dispatch. Preserve existing Elixir oracles as authorities. Run the fixture matrix without blessing first; only regenerate span-sensitive diagnostics/snapshots after showing that each delta is the expected one-byte keyword shift and not a semantic change. Compare compiler telemetry and outputs for representative pre/post programs.

Update `tests/fixture_matrix.rs` main/signature discovery, CLI messages, parser helpers, source fixtures embedded in Rust tests, language-server grammar if applicable, guides, README/northstar, and `.agent/docs`. Replace named-fn terminology with named-function or definition terminology where needed.

## Removal census prepared for the next ticket
Add a checked test/script that enumerates remaining source-level named fn/fnp spellings while allowing anonymous fn. Its allowlist must be structural and small; filenames or broad directories are not acceptable exemptions. Also enumerate code recognizers and runtime macro definitions still awaiting deletion in fz-6lf.4.

## Acceptance
All maintained programs use def/defp, all applicable Elixir twins remain mechanically comparable, every execution path and documentation gate is green, and the only surviving source `fn` forms are anonymous functions plus deliberate negative tests. No maintained fnp use survives outside deliberate negative tests.
title: Migrate the complete FZ corpus and public language contract to def/defp
